messages:
customer_acme: Hi — our users see the streaming response cut off mid-generation ~30s in. Client reconnects and gets the rest but sometimes duplicates tokens. Happening across EU region since yesterday. Request id: r-0a1b2c3d. No errors in client console, just socket closed.

emma_support: sorry to hear that — can you share a curl repro or the exact headers your client sends? are you using a proxy/ALB in front of your clients? @matt_engineering fyi. :eyes:

matt_engineering: probable suspects: proxy idle timeouts or intermediate TCP RST, or proxy squashing comment pings. Also some clients treat SSE newline/comment payloads as keepalive and then reconnect when they see partial frame.

customer_acme: repro with curl attached:
```
curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  "https://api.redwood.example/v1/streams?model=redwood-xl"
```
Response stops after a chunk like:
```
event: chunk
data: {"id":"c1","text":"The quick brown fox jumps"}

```
then socket closes. Client reconnects and sometimes receives the rest starting at "jumps" (dup tokens).

emma_support: thanks. can you paste a short tcpdump or proxy logs showing the FIN/RST around the close? also confirm whether you see any `ALB` or `nginx` idle timeout hits.

customer_acme: here's truncated proxy log: `upstream read timeout after 30s` and then `connection closed by client`. Proxy is an nginx 1.20 with default keepalive settings behind a cloud load balancer.

matt_engineering: ok that matches proxy idle timeout. Two things to consider: (1) enable TCP-level keepalive on the upstream/proxy so OS keeps the connection alive beyond idle timeout; (2) use comment ping SSE messages (":\n\n") every 10s to keep proxies from idling. We avoid sending full data events as pings because some proxies buffer until newline.

emma_support: quick checklist for repro/playbook:
- Confirm client receives a final 2xx and no explicit HTTP error (if not, capture request_id).
- Check proxy/load-balancer idle timeout and align it > expected longest silence (we suggest 60s).
- Turn on `tcp_nodelay`/keepalive on upstreams if using nginx (proxy_socket_keepalive on).
- If using ALB, set idle timeout to >= 60s.
- Add comment pings every 10s server-side: `printf ":\n\n"` between events.

matt_engineering: example SSE ping pattern we use in the runtime:
```
while (not finished) {
  produce_next_chunk(); // may be slow
  if (time_since_last_write > 10s) {
    // bare comment ping — safe for most proxies
    write(":\n\n");
  }
}
```
Note: for some proxies comment pings are fine, but certain HTTP/2 reverse proxies may coalesce or drop them — test per environment.

customer_acme: we tried adding comment pings but still saw proxy close at 30s. We found ALB idle was 30s default. bumping to 120s seems to stop the closes. Any guidance on detecting dead connections in server-side logs?

emma_support: add per-connection last-write timestamps to logs and an event when close occurs with `socket_state` & `last_write_ts`. That helps differentiate client-initiated closes vs proxy timeouts.

matt_engineering: for detection heuristics here are quick rules we use: 
- If socket FIN from client -> client closed.
- If upstream read timeout / 502 from proxy -> proxy closed.
- If connection shows `RST` -> abrupt network issue (could be NAT timeout).
- Track last SSE id sent; on reconnect client sends `Last-Event-ID` header — use that to resume and dedupe tokens server-side.

emma_support: billing note — partial streams: if the client reconnect results in re-generating overlapping tokens, we have safeguards to avoid double-billing on server-side by deduping idempotent chunk ids when possible. Open a support ticket with request id and timestamps if you see double charge.

customer_acme: great, bumped ALB to 120s and enabled proxy_socket_keepalive. We'll add logging of last-write ts and test for a day. thanks! :clap:

sre_bot: deploy 2026-03-15T09:12 UTC — runtime: sse/ping-adjustment rolled to 10s comment pings for hosted endpoints (canary 10%). Monitor: sse.disconnect-rate.

matt_engineering: FYI we'll follow up with an internal doc on best-practice defaults (ALB=120s, 10s comment ping, keepalive on proxies) and an automated probe script customers can run.

emma_support: marking thread: investigating -> resolved after customer confirmed fix. :white_check_mark:
